import http.client, json, math, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
data = Path(tmp.name) / 'nested' / 'data.json'

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen(['python3', str(root/'server.py'), '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', str(data)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    assert p.stdout.readline if True else False
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def req(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=4)
    raw = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    h = dict(headers or {})
    if raw is not None:
        h.setdefault('Content-Type','application/json')
        h.setdefault('Content-Length',str(len(raw)))
    c.request(method,path,body=raw,headers=h)
    r=c.getresponse(); payload=r.read(); out=(r.status,dict(r.getheaders()),payload)
    c.close(); return out

def j(result):
    return json.loads(result[2])

p, port = start()
try:
    r=req(port,'GET','/health'); assert r[0]==200 and j(r)=={'status':'ok'} and r[1]['Content-Type']=='application/json'
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/hello%20world',{'value':{'x':[1,True,None]}})[0]==201
    r=req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/hello%20world'); assert r[0]==200 and j(r)=={'key':'hello world','value':{'x':[1,True,None]}}
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/hello%20world',{'value':'new'})[0]==200
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/z',{'value':0})[0]==201
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a',{'value':1})[0]==201
    assert j(req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'))=={'keys':['a','hello world','z']}
    assert req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/a')[0]==204
    assert req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/a')[0]==404
    for path in ['/v1/kv/', '/v1/kv/a%2Fb', '/v1/kv/%FF']:
        assert req(port,'GET',path)[0]==400, path
    for body in [b'{', b'[]', b'{}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":true}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":1e999}', b'{\"value\":NaN}']:
        assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/bad',body)[0]==400, body
    assert req(port,'POST','/health',{} )[0] in (404,405)
    assert req(port,'GET','/nope')[0]==404
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/huge',b'x'*(1024*1024+1))[0]==413
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/ttl',{'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15})[0]==201
    time.sleep(.25)
    assert req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/ttl')[0]==404
    assert 'ttl' not in j(req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'))['keys']
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); assert p.wait(timeout=5)==0, p.stderr.read()

p2, port2=start()
try:
    assert j(req(port2,'GET','/v1/kv/hello%20world'))=={'key':'hello world','value':'new'}
    assert req(port2,'GET','/v1/kv/ttl')[0]==404
    assert j(req(port2,'GET','/v1/keys'))=={'keys':['hello world','z']}
finally:
    p2.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); assert p2.wait(timeout=5)==0, p2.stderr.read()

on_disk=json.loads(data.read_text())
assert 'ttl' not in on_disk['entries']
print('integration tests passed')
PY"

import http.client, json, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
data = Path(tmp.name) / 'nested' / 'data.json'

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen(
        ['python3', str(root / 'server.py'), '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', str(data)],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
    )
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def stop(p):
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.read())

def req(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=4)
    raw = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    request_headers = dict(headers or {})
    if raw is not None:
        request_headers.setdefault('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        request_headers.setdefault('Content-Length', str(len(raw)))
    conn.request(method, path, body=raw, headers=request_headers)
    response = conn.getresponse()
    result = response.status, dict(response.getheaders()), response.read()
    conn.close()
    return result

def decoded(result):
    return json.loads(result[2])

p, port = start()
try:
    result = req(port, 'GET', '/health')
    assert result[0] == 200 and decoded(result) == {'status': 'ok'}
    assert result[1]['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', {'value': {'x': [1, True, None]}})[0] == 201
    assert decoded(req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world')) == {
        'key': 'hello world', 'value': {'x': [1, True, None]}
    }
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', {'value': 'new'})[0] == 200
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/z', {'value': 0})[0] == 201
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', {'value': 1})[0] == 201
    assert decoded(req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')) == {'keys': ['a', 'hello world', 'z']}
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/a')[0] == 204
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/a')[0] == 404

    for path in ['/v1/kv/', '/v1/kv/a%2Fb', '/v1/kv/%FF']:
        result = req(port, 'GET', path)
        assert 400 <= result[0] < 500 and decoded(result)['error']

    bad_payloads = [
        b'{', b'[]', b'{}', b'{\"value\":1,\"extra\":2}',
        b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":-1}',
        b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":true}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":\"1\"}',
        b'{\"value\":NaN}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":Infinity}',
    ]
    for payload in bad_payloads:
        result = req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/bad', payload)
        assert 400 <= result[0] < 500 and result[1]['Content-Type'] == 'application/json', (payload, result)

    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/toolarge', b'x' * (1024 * 1024 + 1))[0] == 413
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/nolength', b'{\"value\":1}', {'Content-Length': 'abc'})[0] == 400
    for method, path in [('POST', '/health'), ('PATCH', '/v1/kv/z'), ('GET', '/unknown')]:
        result = req(port, method, path)
        assert 400 <= result[0] < 500 and decoded(result)['error'], (method, path, result)

    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/short', {'value': 'gone', 'ttl_seconds': 0.15})[0] == 201
    time.sleep(0.25)
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/short')[0] == 404
    assert 'short' not in decoded(req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys'))['keys']
finally:
    stop(p)

assert data.exists()
p, port = start()
try:
    assert decoded(req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world')) == {'key': 'hello world', 'value': 'new'}
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/short')[0] == 404
    assert decoded(req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')) == {'keys': ['hello world', 'z']}
finally:
    stop(p)

print('integration tests passed')
